run_finetune_vision_transformer: run the MAE-ST fine-tuning training loop for a ViT model on the Kinetics video dataset
run_finetune_evaluation_only: run evaluation only on the validation set using a pre-trained MAE-ST checkpoint
run_finetune_distributed: run distributed multi-GPU fine-tuning with gradient accumulation and layer-wise learning rate decay
run_finetune_with_mixup: run fine-tuning with mixup and cutmix augmentation enabled for improved generalization
run_finetune_single_thread: run the launch_one_thread function to start a single GPU fine-tuning process with shard-based distributed setup
